paper.title: Small Total-Cost Constraints in Contextual Bandits with Knapsacks, with Application to Fairness

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual bandits with knapsacks [CBwK] (hard total-cost constraints, continuous contexts)
unmapped: vector-valued signed costs in [-1,1]^d with average cost constraints B in [0,1]^d (possibly as small as ~1/sqrt(T)); no null-cost action assumed
reward and cost functions uniformly estimable with known error functions eps_t whose sum along played actions is O(sqrt(T) ln(T/delta)) (Assumption 2)
regret compares to T*OPT(r,c,B), the best static policy satisfying expected cost constraints
settings.definition_quote: The action $a_t$ played leads to some scalar reward $r_t \in [0,1]$ and some signed vector-valued cost $\bc_t \in [-1,1]^d$... The number $T$ of rounds is known, and the learner must play in a way such that $\bc_1 + \ldots + \bc_T \leq T \bB$.

settings.name_in_paper: CBwK with soft constraints, primal strategy with estimation of the context distribution
unmapped: total costs allowed to exceed T*B by 2alpha+beta+2Xi (soft constraints)
context distribution nu estimable uniformly over bounded functions with errors xi_t (Notation 1)
settings.definition_quote: we allow deviations to $T \bB$ of the order of $\sqrt{T}$ times poly-log factors: this is what we refer to as ``soft'' constraints.

settings.name_in_paper: CBwK with hard constraints, primal strategy with estimation of the context distribution
unmapped: context distribution nu estimable uniformly over bounded functions with errors xi_t (Notation 1)
settings.definition_quote: We now turn our attention to the main kind of result that we want to achieve: when constraints must be strictly satisfied---which we refer to as ``hard'' constraints.

algorithms.name: Box B: Projected gradient descent for CBwK with fixed step size
Box C: Projected gradient descent for CBwK with adaptive step size (PGD Adaptive)
Box D: Primal CBwK strategy (generalized from Li and Stoltz 2022)

symbols.lambda_norm: Euclidean norm of the optimal dual variable lambda*_{B-b1}
symbols.gamma: step size of the projected gradient descent

conditions: problem feasible for some B' < B - b1

source.label: lm:C
source.quote: the Box~B strategy run with $\delta/4$ ensures that the costs satisfy, with probability at least $1-\delta$, \forall 1 \leq t \leq T, \left\Arrowvert \left( \sum_{\tau=1}^t \bc_\tau - t\,(\bB-b\bone) \right)_+ \right\Arrowvert \leq \frac{1 + 3\Arrowvert \blambda^\star_{\bB-b\bone} \Arrowvert}{\gamma} + 20 \sqrt{d} \, \dev_{T,\delta}.

results.notes: Bound on the Euclidean norm of the positive part of the cumulative cost excess over t(B-b1), uniformly over t.

symbols.b: margin on the average cost constraints

conditions: problem feasible for some B' < B - b1

source.label: lm:R
source.quote:
Fix $\delta \in (0,1)$ and $0 < b < \min \bB$.
Under the same assumptions as in Lemma~\ref{lm:C} and
on the same event with probability at least $1-\delta$ as therein,
the regret of the Box~B strategy run with $\delta/4$ satisfies
\[
\forall \, 1 \leq t \leq T, \qquad
R_t
\leq
\Arrowvert \blambda^\star_{\bB-b\bone} \Arrowvert \Bigl( t\,b \sqrt{d} + 6 \dev_{T,\delta} \Bigr)
+ 36 \gamma \sqrt{d}\, \bigl( \dev_{T,\delta} \bigr)^2 + 8 \smash{\ln \frac{T^2}{\delta/4}}\,.
\]

results.notes: Stated for all t <= T; recorded at t = T. Regret is T*OPT(r,c,B) - sum r_t (realized rewards), on the same event as Lemma 1.

symbols.lambda_norm: Euclidean norm of the optimal dual variable lambda*_{B - b_T 1}

tuning: margin b_T = (1 + ilog T)(M_{T,delta,ilog T} + 2 sqrt(d))/T
step sizes gamma_k = 2^k/sqrt(T) in regimes k
regime k run with risk delta/(4(k+2)^2)

source.label: th:DT
source.quote: If the average cost constraints $\bB$ are such that $\bB \geq 2 b_T \bone$ and if the problem $(r,\bc,\bB - 2 b_T \bone,\nu)$ is feasible, then this meta-strategy satisfies, with probability at least $1-\delta$: R_T \leq \tO ( ( 1 + \Arrowvert \blambda^\star_{\bB-b_T\bone} \Arrowvert ) \sqrt{T} ) and \sum_{t \leq T} \bc_t \leq T \bB

results.notes: Simultaneously guarantees hard constraint satisfaction sum c_t <= TB w.h.p. Closed-form bound in eq. (meta-regret-bound). Lemma 3/Cor 1 bound lambda_norm by (OPT(B-b)-OPT(B~))/min(B-b-B~), and by 2(OPT(B)-OPT(0))/min B with a null-cost action.

symbols.beta_T: sum of estimation errors beta_{T,delta/4} from Assumption 2
symbols.Xi_T: sum of context-distribution estimation errors Xi_{T,delta/4}

conditions: context distribution estimable as in Notation 1
costs may exceed T*B by (2alpha_T + beta_T + 2Xi_T) per coordinate

source.label: prop:soft-known-nu
source.quote: the strategy of Box~D, run with $\delta/4$ and positive slacks $b_t = \xi_{t-1,\delta/4}$, ensures that with probability at least $1-\delta$, \sum_{t=1}^T \bc_t \leq T \bB + ( 2 \alpha_{T,\delta/4} + \beta_{T,\delta/4} + 2 \Xi_{T,\delta/4} ) \bone and R_T \leq 2 \alpha_{T,\delta/4} + \beta_{T,\delta/4} + 2 \Xi_{T,\delta/4}

results.notes: Soft constraints. When X is finite this is O_tilde(sqrt(T)). Box D may be hard to compute for non-finitely-supported estimates of nu.

conditions: context distribution estimable as in Notation 1

source.label: th:hard-known-nu
source.quote: Assume that a null-cost action exists, that $\oD_{T,\delta/4} < \min \bB$, that Assumption~\ref{ass:est} holds... Then, with probability at least $1-\delta$, \sum_{t=1}^T \bc_t \leq T \bB and R_T \leq ( 2 \alpha_{T,\delta/4} + \beta_{T,\delta/4} + 2 \Xi_{T,\delta/4} ) ( 1 + \frac{\opt(r,\bc,\bB) - \opt(r,\bc,\bzero)}{\min \bB} ).

results.notes: Revisits main result of Li and Stoltz (2022). Hard constraints satisfied w.h.p.

symbols.m_min: smallest component of the margin vector m

conditions: problem is (B - m)-feasible for some m (unknown to the strategy) with min m >= (2alpha_T + beta_T + 2Xi_T)/T
context distribution estimable as in Notation 1

source.label: th:hard-gal
source.quote: Assume that the problem is $(\bB - \bsf)$--feasible for some $\bm$ that does not need to be known by the strategy, with $\bB - \bsf \leq \bB - \oD'_{T,\delta/4} \bone$. Then... with probability at least $1-\delta$, \sum_{t=1}^T \bc_t \leq T \bB and R_T \leq ( 2 \alpha_{T,\delta/4} + \beta_{T,\delta/4} + 2 \Xi_{T,\delta/4} ) ( 1 + \frac{\opt(r,\bc,\bB) - \opt(r,\bc,\bB-\bm)}{\min \bm} )

results.notes: No null-cost action needed. Hard constraints satisfied w.h.p.
